conversation_before.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I think I might have lost my wallet with both of my debit cards in it. I have two checking accounts with you — my Bluest Account and my Light Green Account. I’ve been looking everywhere and I can’t find my wallet. I’m not 100% sure it’s gone but I’m getting worried about both cards.

Sorry to hear that — I can help. Since you have two checking accounts (Bluest and Light Green) and both debit cards might be in the missing wallet, here are the safest next steps and what I can do for you:

Options (what they mean)
- Temporary freeze (recommended if you’re still looking): immediately blocks new transactions but can be undone if you find the card. Pending authorizations may still settle.
- Close (permanent): permanently deactivates the card and prevents any future use. You’ll need to order a new debit card to replace it.
- Keep watching: if you’re sure the wallet is just misplaced and you don’t want any action yet, monitor transactions and report any unauthorized charges immediately.

What I recommend
- Temporarily freeze both debit cards now so they can’t be used while you look for the wallet. If you later find a card, we can unfreeze it. If you confirm the cards are lost or stolen, we can close them and order replacements.

Important notes
- If either card is actually stolen or there are unauthorized transactions, Regulation E protections apply — report unauthorized charges as soon as you notice them.
- After we verify your identity, I’ll also check whether you have any Rho-Bank credit cards and, if so, offer to protect those as well (replacement with a new number) since wallet loss can affect multiple cards.

Before I can take any action (freeze or close) or look up card details, I need to verify your identity. Would you like me to proceed with verification now so I can freeze both cards? If yes, I’ll explain the verification steps and proceed. Also, have you seen any suspicious or unauthorized transactions on either account so far?

Yes, please freeze BOTH cards right away. That way if someone finds my wallet they can’t use either card. I’ll keep looking.

And yes, you can proceed with verification. I haven’t noticed any suspicious transactions so far, but I’m really anxious about it.

Okay — I’ll start by verifying your identity so I can freeze both cards. To look up your account I need either your full name (as it appears on the account) or your user ID. After I look up your record I’ll ask you to confirm any 2 of these on-file items: date of birth, email, phone number, or address.

Please provide your full name (or user ID) so I can proceed.
